Learned Additional Government Advocate Mr. Mohanty submits that the process sent by the Court through police has been duly served on the accused persons.
There is no reason to doubt this version.
3. Names of the accused are called out loudly by the Court Master on our instruction.
There is no response from them.
4. Appeal is filed after brooking delay of 200 days.
An application, supported by affidavit, seeking its condonation accompanies the appeal memo.
A perusal of the same shows that there is a plausible explanation for the delay brooked.
Even otherwise, appeal involves arguable points on merits.
One of the offences alleged against accused persons is punishable under section 376 (2)(g) of IPC.
In view of above, the application having been favoured, delay is condoned.
The I.A. is disposed of.

Call the main case (CRLLP No.159 of 2016) on 26.08.2025.
